description: Node.js process memory usage keeps growing over time, eventually OOMKilled in production
expectedSolution: Profile with --inspect, check for event listener accumulation, unclosed streams, or growing caches without TTL

description: Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use :::3000 when starting Express server
expectedSolution: Kill the existing process using the port: lsof -i :3000 then kill -9 PID, or use a different port

description: Writable stream highWaterMark exceeded, data loss during high-throughput file processing
expectedSolution: Use stream.pipeline() or handle drain event properly. Check write() return value and pause on false

description: process.env.DATABASE_URL is undefined in production despite being set in .env file
expectedSolution: Ensure dotenv.config() is called before accessing env vars, or load .env in production deployment config

description: 429 Too Many Requests from third-party API. Need to implement rate limiting for outgoing requests
expectedSolution: Implement request queue with rate limiting using bottleneck or p-limit. Add exponential backoff on 429

description: Spawned child processes become zombies, not properly cleaned up on parent exit
expectedSolution: Handle process exit/SIGTERM events to kill child processes. Use child.unref() or proper cleanup handlers

description: Crypto.createCipher is deprecated and insecure, need to migrate to createCipheriv
expectedSolution: Replace createCipher with createCipheriv using a random IV. Use aes-256-gcm for authenticated encryption

description: Worker processes not gracefully shutting down in Node.js cluster, losing in-flight requests
expectedSolution: On SIGTERM: stop accepting new connections, drain existing requests, then process.exit after timeout

description: MaxListenersExceededWarning: Possible EventEmitter memory leak detected. 11 listeners added
expectedSolution: Use .once() instead of .on() for one-time handlers, or properly remove listeners with .off() in cleanup

description: UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE when making HTTPS request to internal service with self-signed cert
expectedSolution: Pass the CA certificate to the https agent, or set rejectUnauthorized for development only (never in production)

description: TypeError: Do not know how to serialize a BigInt when calling JSON.stringify
expectedSolution: Use a custom JSON replacer function or convert BigInt to string/number before serialization

description: Worker threads not sharing memory correctly, data inconsistency in parallel processing
expectedSolution: Use SharedArrayBuffer with Atomics for shared memory, or structured clone for message passing

description: ENOTFOUND: DNS resolution failing intermittently for external API calls in containerized environment
expectedSolution: Configure DNS resolver, add retry logic with dns.setServers(), or fix container DNS configuration

description: EMFILE: too many open files when processing large directory of files concurrently
expectedSolution: Limit concurrent file operations with p-limit or use graceful-fs. Increase ulimit if needed

description: Date calculations are wrong in production because server timezone differs from expected UTC
expectedSolution: Set TZ=UTC environment variable, or always use UTC methods (toISOString, Date.UTC) for consistency
